en: Black‑and‑white image of a large neo‑Romanesque / neo‑Gothic church with two tall octagonal towers topped by domes and crosses, and a third, more slender spire to the left. The nave has tall pointed‑arch windows with tracery and buttresses. In the foreground is a small landscaped square with trees and a polygonal fountain or monument crowned by a statue. A few pedestrians walk along the cobbled street surrounding the church. The image has the margins and wear typical of an old photographic postcard or plate.
